From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@cobalthealth.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coupa onboarding — a few contract/portal questions

Hi Rachel —

We're starting the Coupa vendor activation for Cobalt Health next week and wanted to surface a few contract and portal items so we can avoid last-minute hold-ups:

- Order form: the procurement team flagged that our PO acknowledgement SLA and PO number mapping need explicit language in the order form. Can Redwood accept standard PO number in the PO header and pass it to invoices?
- MSA redlines: we have one ask on data retention (12 months) and an Appendix request for telemetry/logging for audit purposes. Would Redwood consider an Appendix for audit logs instead of changing the core MSA?
- SSO / SCIM: Coupa wants to do SSO via SAML; we may need a technical contact to coordinate identity proofing.
- Tax/Remit: the portal requires specific remit fields and a tax_id attribute — confirm if these can be populated automatically when vendor is created.

Attached is our Coupa onboarding guide. Can you confirm timelines and next steps? We want to be live before month-end.

Thanks —
Anna Lopez

Legal note (summary):
- Data retention: Cobalt's ask for 12 months retention is reasonable for vendor logs, propose we add Appendix A that scopes telemetry retention to 12 months and lists accepted data types.
- PO acknowledgement & mapping: we prefer not to rewrite core MSA for PO mechanics — include explicit order form language for PO number mapping and acknowledgement SLA.
- Appendix for audit logs: acceptable as long as access and redaction controls are defined.

I've attached preliminary comments in a redline of the Order Form and a short MSA Appendix template. Kim/Tessa — can ops confirm whether the Coupa field map supports a 'tax_id' and 'remit_address' at vendor create time? If yes, we'll draft the Order Form language and aim for signature.

- PO passthrough: Our connector preserves PO number header (PO_NUMBER) and populates invoice.POReference if present. We will validate a sample PO during activation.
- SSO/SCIM: I'll be the technical contact for identity proofing; let's schedule a 30-min SAML exchange next Tue (15 Jun) — I'll invite ProcureIT.
- Onboarding plan:
